items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: who's an old friend of Maxine's

ctx.x: I want to write a footnote here.
At the start of Session 3, we were joined by Mr. Chester Campbell, Jr., who's an old friend of Maxine's and whose father had been a musician who played with Cliff Jackson.

Mr. Campbell and Maxine Sullivan had a lengthy and very lively conversation for which I kept the tape rolling. However, not all of it was appropriate to the purpose of the oral history project and therefore what I've done is delete some passages that strayed too far away from talking about Maxine Sullivan and the jazz scene.
